messages:
rosa_sales: Heads-up: Carla's team wants to add a live rerank plus BYO-KMS to the pilot. Security and scope both flagged. Can we align on a narrow path to keep the POC schedule?

sam_se: Quick summary of constraints: customer wants near-real-time rerank, BYO-KMS for at-rest keys, and longer audit log retention (12 months). Rerank adds an extra model call per query.

anya_pm: Current POC success criteria are: 1) 95th <400ms for gen-only, 2) quality target precision@5 >=0.78. If we add rerank we need to update latency and precision targets.

mike_sec: BYO-KMS is doable with envelope encryption. We need a documented KMS handshake and proof of key separation. 12 months retention requires legal review; may delay sign-off ~2 weeks.

devin_eng: Perf note: realtime rerank on hosted likely increases 95th latency. Options: lightweight rerank (embedding compare) or full model rerank. Embedding rerank can be int8 and use KV cache to keep latency modest. We can also enable short batching window (15-25ms).

carla_cust: They're asking for production-like behavior in POC so prefer live rerank. They'd accept a slightly higher latency if we document it. Also they insisted on BYO-KMS.

rosa_sales: Tradeoffs to present to customer: A) Keep current scope, simulate rerank offline for metrics. B) Add lightweight live rerank and accept new SLO (95th <=600ms) for combined path. C) Run a short Dedicated trial to meet original SLOs (costly). Which do we want to propose?

sam_se: Recommend B as middle ground. I'll draft a one-pager with acceptance criteria changes, estimated cost delta, and BYO-KMS steps.

anya_pm: For B, acceptance criteria proposal: 95th <=600ms generate+rerank, precision@5 >=0.80, streaming integration remains stable. Also require request-level tracing and token-cost header.

mike_sec: I'll prepare security blurb: KMS handshake flow, rotation runbook, and what we log/export. If they require 12mo retention on hosted we'll need legal approval; note that retention affects storage cost.

devin_eng: I'll spin a small perf spike with: batch_window_ms=20, kv_cache_ttl=30m, rerank_model=int8 and report median/95th numbers in 48h.

rosa_sales: Carla, can you confirm whether they can accept 600ms for the POC and start legal for retention?

carla_cust: I'll escalate now. They prefer 600ms if we show a clear perf plan and cost impact. I'll confirm BYO-KMS feasibility on their side as well.

integration-bot: note: presales/one-pager-draft uploaded by sam_se at /sheets/presales/1890123456-byo-kms-rerank.pdf

sam_se: Cost back-of-envelope: hosted baseline ~$2.5k/week. Lightweight rerank + extra calls ~+1.1k/week. Dedicated trial (4 GPUs) ~ $11k/week but gives lower tail latency.

rosa_sales: Great. Sam, Mike, Devin 3 can we have the one-pager + perf numbers by EOD tomorrow? I'll attach to the SOW.

mike_sec: Yep, I'll review the security section once draft is up.

devin_eng: Spike card created, ETA 48h. I'll include the micro-bench and config snippet.

carla_cust: Thanks team, I'll reply with customer decision by EOD.

rosa_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:
